title: Fullbright
description: Fullbright is a Minecraft feature or mod that brightens the game, making dark areas like caves clearly visible without changing the time of day. It just improves visibility.
body: ![DOTTERTOP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31ba401b8449bb73598a585d067f6c988764f9f4.png) ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8af6876fb7538e2c5ed82e8846467890bf8f91a6.png) [![Available for Fabric](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07ec2f53805d1c305d2eea8f5bd42a41e8b3f016.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fullb/versions?l=fabric) [![Available for Forge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/180105de90be33ffed2de93e902256b07f0fecbb.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fullb/versions?l=forge) [![Modrinth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7faa28925ea4ba02cc1316deb77cab692a357eac.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fullb) [![GitHub](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01c4e87c85b4398d59257c2b13e14ea855d45bad.png)](https://www.github.com/Erdemstandi/fullbright) [![CurseForge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f1759aa7fbae714c2e28c8057ec3282597d7408.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fullb) ![FullBright](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44138bede97beb4fb5070ab1503fe1a0816dfe09.png)glows your world by effecting brightness. Caves, spawners and many other dark areas look dark with the vanilla features, so Fullbright removes the dark and lights your world without causing any performance drop ![GLASSERS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c72302b253b68e1eef2847a39f7049ebaf9b49c4.png) ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c435077583adaa21b6b9492e8d654824ff8c7b9.png) ### **Changeable Key** With changeable key you can change the toggle key according to your preference the default button is set to "B" ### **Language Support** With language support, the toggle outputs and the keybinds menu will fit way better to your game the most used languages are supported. ### **Light-weight** With light-weight there will not be any performance loss ### **Client-side** With client-side the mod will work everywhere without any problem ### **Pure Fabric** With pure fabric, no API will be required ![DOTERS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/feb10633e8da9f398be8975d41fd99476650ed43.png) ![NOTEPAD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b10babc7d1df3e3a89cf9a2489ed509c20528032.png)
